decision_needed: Approve replacing the July 2026 region-level diesel proxy with the date-aligned 2025-02-12 city/price-zone values registered by the audit.
recommended_choice: Approve 7.48 Beijing; 7.43 Tianjin and Shijiazhuang/Hebei; 7.44 Guangzhou/Shenzhen/Dongguan/Foshan; 7.48 Chengdu; 7.50 Chongqing yuan/L.
alternative: Keep the old proxy only if the paper explicitly changes the scenario date or declares an asynchronous price sensitivity; this is not recommended.
why_it_matters: Fuel cost affects every China81 solution and all private-table comparisons. Activating it requires a full China E2 rerun.
authorized_action_after_choice: Build runtime authority v4 and corrected bundles; do not search until D2-D5 are also frozen.

decision_needed: Choose a constructed but operationally plausible finite fleet and depot-charger capacity rule. Current num_cv=num_ev=customer count is nonbinding and 2 x 22 kW per depot is an unsupported uniform proxy.
recommended_choice: Use an algorithm-independent sizing rule based only on demand/time-window inputs, then add a preregistered reserve factor and run sensitivity around it; keep charger counts/power as explicit constructed-scenario parameters rather than observed facility facts.
alternative: Adopt fixed size-tier tables, but they need a source and can create arbitrary discontinuities.
why_it_matters: E3 cross-depot value, multi-trip feasibility, station congestion, E5 nonlinear charging, E6 participation, and E7 dynamics all depend on scarce physical assets.
authorized_action_after_choice: Draft a source-backed sizing contract and run zero-search feasibility/adversarial checks before any formal experiment.

recommended_choice: Control: every customer is locked to its registered home depot and no cross-depot service is feasible; treatment: the lock is removed and reciprocal cross-depot neighborhoods are enabled, with identical inputs, initial solution construction, seed, budget, evaluator, and certificate.
alternative: A weaker control that only disables one cross-depot operator is not recommended because other operators can still cross depots.
why_it_matters: Current task labels do not execute the intended mechanism, and the scorer only annotates cross-site service.
authorized_action_after_choice: Implement an explicit lock and independent zero-forbidden-service witness for the control; bind the responsibility-map hash in both arms.

decision_needed: Choose the primary formal stopping rule.
recommended_choice: Use a deterministic complete-candidate evaluation budget shared by paired arms; retain wall clock only as a generous safety cap and report CPU separately.
alternative: Keep convergence plus wall clock, but then do not claim cross-machine reproducibility or equal compute.
why_it_matters: Wall-clock stopping changes the number of iterations with machine/library/thread variation and can bias paired arms.
authorized_action_after_choice: Freeze numeric budgets after a no-result pilot that measures only evaluation throughput and feasibility.

decision_needed: Choose whether route-pool recombination must be mathematically exact.
recommended_choice: Rename it as time-limited MIP route-pool recombination, retain incumbent/gap/status, and remove exact from the algorithm name and prose unless optimality is proved.
alternative: Require result.success plus a proved zero MIP gap before accepting a recombination; this preserves the exact label but may change runtime and results.
why_it_matters: The current code accepts a feasible incumbent after timeout. Calling it exact is unsupported.
authorized_action_after_choice: Version the algorithm boundary, paper naming, metadata, and witness schema before rerunning E2/E3.

decision_needed: Approve the minimum rerun boundary after D1-D5 are frozen.
recommended_choice: Rerun the complete China81 E2 private campaign and representative-instance S3-S5, then run E3 only. Preserve public P1 and replay its sealed witnesses under the new checker without optimization.
alternative: Rerun public P1 as well; unnecessary unless no-search replay finds a new violation.
why_it_matters: 54 instances have changed geography, 15 Chengdu instances changed carbon mapping, and all 81 change under date-aligned diesel. Existing private tables and figures are not corrected-authority evidence.
authorized_action_after_choice: Create a versioned E2-corrected campaign; regenerate paper exhibits only from new sealed evidence; keep old HALT/PASS artifacts historical.
